defect: pulse interpretation after an isolated reset is unspecified
rationale: The source toggle and destination history can be reset independently; without a system rule for whether either reset is allowed during an outstanding event, the receiver may legitimately see a pulse or miss one and the RTL cannot decide which behavior is required.

mutation.description: Kept separate source and destination resets around the pulse synchronizer state.

provenance.adaptation: Removed the reset coupling and assertion scaffolding from the reduced pulse synchronizer.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Toggle pulse sync with independent resets: resetting only one side leaves a toggle mismatch and a spurious pulse; sequencing is unstated.
